tasks.subject: Task 1: structured.py extractor + heuristic selectors + unit tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure, fail-open structured extractor over raw HTML, with tunable heuristic selectors in `config.py`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/growth_scraper/structured.py`
- Modify: `src/growth_scraper/config.py`
- Test: `tests/test_structured.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `extract_structured(html)` returns dict with entityType/source/name/description/image/price/rating/reviews(cap 3)/category/contact/itemCount
- Source priority JSON-LD > microdata > meta > heuristic
- Never raises; empty/broken/no-signal → None
- Config exposes STRUCTURED_*_SELECTORS + STRUCTURED_MAX_JSONLD_BYTES

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_structured.py -q` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/growth_scraper/structured.py", "src/growth_scraper/config.py", "tests/test_structured.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_structured.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["extract_structured unit tests pass", "source priority enforced", "fail-open on empty/broken HTML"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire structured into record, summary triage + CSV, fixture routes + e2e tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every record exposes `structured`; `summary` gets cheap triage fields; the CSV mirrors them; fixture pages + e2e tests prove it through the browser.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/growth_scraper/pipeline.py`, `src/growth_scraper/config.py`, `src/growth_scraper/records.py`
- Modify: `tests/fixtureserver.py`
- Test: `tests/test_structured.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `record.structured` populated for fixture pages
- summary has structuredSource/Price/RatingValue/ReviewCount/Category when structured exists, absent when not
- CSV header + rows include the 5 structured* columns
- Existing 24 tests still green

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/ -q` → 24 old + new pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/growth_scraper/pipeline.py", "src/growth_scraper/config.py", "src/growth_scraper/records.py", "tests/fixtureserver.py", "tests/test_structured.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/ -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["record.structured populated", "summary triage fields", "CSV structured* columns"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Per-run ScrapeConfig in Pipeline.run_one (concurrency-safe)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `run_one` accepts an optional per-run `ScrapeConfig` so the server can serve concurrent requests with different options without mutating shared state.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/growth_scraper/pipeline.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- run_one(url, crawled_from=None, cfg=None) uses passed cfg everywhere
- Hooks read consent/expand/apis from session cfg
- Cached records return with fromCache=True
- Existing 24 tests still green

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/ -q` → all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/growth_scraper/pipeline.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/ -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["per-run cfg respected", "hooks use session cfg", "fromCache set on cache hit"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: gscrape serve — warm-browser HTTP server + endpoint tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `gscrape serve` runs a FastAPI server on 127.0.0.1 with a warm crawler; `POST /scrape` returns a full record; cache fast-path and token support included.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/growth_scraper/server.py`
- Modify: `src/growth_scraper/cli.py`, `pyproject.toml`
- Test: `tests/test_server.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- gscrape serve dispatches before URL parsing
- GET /health → status ok + version
- POST /scrape → record; blocked/error in record (200); invalid body/non-http → 400
- Cache fast-path with fromCache:true, no re-hit
- Token → 401 on missing/wrong bearer
- fastapi/uvicorn/httpx declared

**Verify:** `uv sync` ok; `uv run pytest tests/test_server.py -q` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/growth_scraper/server.py", "src/growth_scraper/cli.py", "pyproject.toml", "tests/test_server.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_server.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["health endpoint", "scrape returns record", "cache fast-path", "token 401", "400 on invalid body"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Hybrid orpheus.sh (server first, spawn fallback) + scenario-server.sh
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `orpheus.sh` tries `POST /scrape` on the local server first; if unreachable/invalid, falls back to spawning `uv run gscrape`. Exit-0/text contract unchanged.

**Files:**
- Modify: `~/.claude/scripts/orpheus.sh` (outside repo)
- Create: `scripts/scenario-server.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Live server → text via HTTP, exit 0
- Server down / GSCRAPE_SKIP_SERVER=1 → same text via spawn
- --out writes JSONL in both paths
- Blocked/error record → exit 1 + stderr, no spawn retry
- `--` flags force spawn
- scenario-server.sh validates warm/cache/fallback

**Verify:** `bash scripts/scenario-server.sh` → PASS (live)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/scenario-server.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash scripts/scenario-server.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["warm path via server", "fallback to spawn", "scenario 6 PASS"]}
```
